# `csharp_wrap_before_binary_opsign`

When a binary chain breaks, start the new line with the operator.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `true`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

### `csharp_wrap_before_binary_opsign = true`

```ini
max_line_length = 80
csharp_wrap_chained_binary_expressions = chop_if_long
csharp_wrap_before_binary_opsign = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public bool IsValid(string name, int count)
    {
        return name.Length > 0 && count > 0 && count < 100 && name != "none" && name != "all";
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public bool IsValid(string name, int count)
    {
        return name.Length > 0
            && count > 0
            && count < 100
            && name != "none"
            && name != "all";
    }
}
```
:::

::::
